measure_description: LUT data is reused from LWV007 via linked_profile. I verified the equivalence with my own measurement of all 255 brightness steps on a Shelly Plus 1PM with a resistive dummy load and 5 samples per point: mean difference to LWV007 -0.024 W, median -0.020 W, and -0.019 W above brightness 128. Standby measured 0.05 W, matching LWV007. My own data is noisier than LWV007's (64 monotonicity regressions out of 254 against 27) because a single 7 W bulb behind an 8 W dummy load sits inside the meter's quantisation at the bottom of the range, so linking is the better choice than contributing my own LUT.
name: Hue White Filament Bulb ST64 E27 580lm 7W
